_note: Reports (§4.1). Each one states a measurement and stops — no recommendation, no offer, no naming of the tenet that would have helped. The test every line below has to pass is one question: could two players read this and reasonably do different things? 'Three went under the threshold and died' passes, because leaving them to die is a real answer and so is buying Parley threshold. 'You should be parleying' fails, and so does anything that names a purchase. Most are `once: run` because a thing that keeps happening should keep being reported; the ones that are a first-time measurement rather than a pattern are `once: profile`.

defs.title: Three went under and died
defs.body: {signalCount:recruit:missed} enemies dropped below the 30% persuade threshold this run and were killed. The last was a {last:recruit:missed.name} at {last:recruit:missed.hpPct}. None was approached.

defs.title: Talking is costing swings
defs.body: {signalCount:recruit:failed} parley attempts landed on nothing this run. Each one was a full gauge fill that dealt no damage, and each failure leaves the target harder to persuade than it was.

defs.title: Dying further forward than their Role
defs.body: {signalCount:ally:down_front} of your units went down standing ahead of where their Role would place them — the last was {last:ally:down_front.name}, a {last:ally:down_front.role}. The front row draws about 60% of single-target aggro.

defs.title: Down the stairs at {last:descend:wounded.hpPct}
defs.body: The party took the stairs off floor {last:descend:wounded.floor} at {last:descend:wounded.hpPct} average health, with {last:descend:wounded.down} down. A won fight returns a quarter of a maximum; a campfire returns all of it and picks up the fallen.

defs.title: The party turned over {signalCount:recruit:cut} times
defs.body: {signalCount:recruit:cut} units were dropped this run to make room for the next recruit — most recently {last:recruit:cut.name}. Nothing that leaves comes back, and coherence is measured on whoever is standing at the end.

defs.title: Recruits refused for want of a slot
defs.body: {signalCount:recruit:declined} units were talked round this run and then turned away, because the party was at twelve and nothing could be cut.

defs.title: {last:unit:branch.name} chose for itself
defs.body: It reached level {last:unit:branch.at}, was offered two branches, and took the first one. Levelling does not wait, so a branch is decided the instant it is earned.

defs.title: The Hollow Sovereign fell
defs.body: A boss is one unit with phases, immune to persuasion, and it ends the run at the bottom of the dungeon rather than at the stairs.

defs.title: Floor {last:run:end.floor} again
defs.body: This run ended on floor {last:run:end.floor}. Foes gain about a level and a half per floor, and the party gains what it earns from the fights it survives.
